name: Beastheart
summary: A beastheart never fights alone! You travel with a ferocious beast by your side—no trained pet, but an untamed creature such as a wolf, a basilisk, or even a young dragon. Bound to you by a primordial connection, your companion honors your wishes just as you are guided by their instincts. But beware! As battle rages on, your companion may succumb to a blood-soaked rampage, lashing out at enemies and friends alike.
description:
A beastheart never fights alone! You travel with a ferocious beast by your side—no trained pet, but an untamed creature such as a wolf, a basilisk, or even a young dragon. Bound to you by a primordial connection, your companion honors your wishes just as you are guided by their instincts. But beware! As battle rages on, your companion may succumb to a blood-soaked rampage, lashing out at enemies and friends alike.

As a beastheart, you face the world's dangers alongside your wild companion. With your combined might, you rush into the thick of combat to challenge enemy champions or prowl around the outskirts to pick off vulnerable foes.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with a Might of 2 and an Intuition of 2, and can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristic scores:
properties.skills: You gain the Animal Handling skill. Then choose any two skills from the exploration or intrigue skill groups.

source: The Beastheart for Draw Steel (mcdm.beastheart.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Censor
summary: Demons and deathless fear you. Criminals run from the sight of your shadow. Agents of chaos, blasphemers, and heretics tremble at the sound of your voice. You carry the power of the gods, armed with wrath and sent out into the world first to seek, then censor those whose actions—or even existence—are anathema to your church.
description:
Demons and deathless fear you. Criminals run from the sight of your shadow. Agents of chaos, blasphemers, and heretics tremble at the sound of your voice. You carry the power of the gods, armed with wrath and sent out into the world first to seek, then censor those whose actions—or even existence—are anathema to your church.

As a censor, you're at your best against the strongest foes. Your judgment terrifies heretics, stops enemies in their tracks, and even hurls them across the battlefield.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with a Might of 2 and a Presence of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristic scores:
properties.skills: Choose any two skills from the interpersonal or lore skill groups.

subclasses.name: Exorcist
subclasses.summary: An order of censors who hunt their order's hidden enemies.
subclasses.description: You have the Read Person skill. Judgment order benefit: the first time on a turn you judge a creature, you can teleport up to twice your Presence score in squares, ending closer to it; you don't need line of effect. The order also shapes the censor features you gain at higher levels.

subclasses.name: Oracle
subclasses.summary: An order of censors who uncover clandestine threats to their order.
subclasses.description: You have the Magic skill. Judgment order benefit: the first time on a turn you judge a creature, you can deal it holy damage equal to twice your Presence score. The order also shapes the censor features you gain at higher levels.

subclasses.name: Paragon
subclasses.summary: An order of censors who set the example for their order.
subclasses.description: You have the Lead skill. Judgment order benefit: the first time on a turn you judge a creature, you can vertical pull it up to twice your Presence score in squares. The order also shapes the censor features you gain at higher levels.

source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Conduit
summary: The power of the gods flows through you! As a vessel for divine power, you don't just keep your allies in the fight. You make those allies more effective, even as you rain divine energy down upon your foes. Though the deity or saint you serve might have other faithful and clergy, you are special among worshippers, receiving your abilities from the highest source.
description:
The power of the gods flows through you! As a vessel for divine power, you don't just keep your allies in the fight. You make those allies more effective, even as you rain divine energy down upon your foes. Though the deity or saint you serve might have other faithful and clergy, you are special among worshippers, receiving your abilities from the highest source.

As a conduit, you heal and buff your allies, and debuff your foes while smiting them with divine magic. The spark of divinity within you shines, filling your enemies with awe and making you more worldly and aware.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with an Intuition of 2, and can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristic scores:
properties.skills: Choose any two skills from the interpersonal or lore skill groups.

subclasses.name: Creation
subclasses.summary: The domain of making things, with stone walls and objects conjured from thought.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Hands of the Maker (a maneuver that creates a mundane object of size 1S or smaller, up to your Intuition score of them at once). Skill group: Crafting. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that a creature within 10 squares uses an area ability. Prayer effect: a wall of stone within 10 squares, size 5 + your Intuition score, lasting to the end of the encounter.

subclasses.name: Death
subclasses.summary: The domain of the dead and of curses.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Grave Speech (a maneuver to speak with a creature that died in the last 24 hours, once per creature). Skill group: Lore. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that a non-minion creature within 10 squares is reduced to 0 Stamina, or a solo creature within 10 squares becomes winded. Prayer effect: curse up to two enemies within 10 squares, each taking corruption damage equal to twice your Intuition score.

subclasses.name: Fate
subclasses.summary: The domain of omens and of nudging how things turn out.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Oracular Visions (you earn fate points equal to the Victories you earn and spend one to grant a creature within 10 squares an edge on a test). Skill group: Lore. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that an ally within 10 squares obtains a tier 3 outcome on a power roll, or an enemy within 10 squares obtains a tier 1 outcome. Prayer effect: a creature within 10 squares automatically gets a tier 1 or tier 3 outcome (your choice) on its next power roll this encounter.

subclasses.name: Knowledge
subclasses.summary: The domain of learning, lore and comprehension.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Blessing of Comprehension (you count as fluent in all languages for understanding a crafting or research project source). Skill group: Lore. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that the Director spends Malice. Prayer effect: up to five allies within 10 squares, or yourself in place of one ally, each gain 1 surge.

subclasses.name: Life
subclasses.summary: The domain of healing and recovery.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Revitalizing Ritual (at each respite you give yourself or one ally a bonus to recovery value equal to your level until your next respite). Skill group: Exploration. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that a creature within 10 squares regains Stamina. Prayer effect: yourself or one ally within 10 squares spends a Recovery, ends an effect, or stands up; or you or an ally gains temporary Stamina equal to twice your Intuition score.

subclasses.name: Love
subclasses.summary: The domain of compassion and of helping others.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Blessing of Compassion (you gain an edge on tests to assist another creature, and at the start of a negotiation one NPC gains 1 patience (max 5) and the first test to influence them gains an edge). Skill group: Interpersonal. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that you or an ally within 10 squares uses the Aid Attack maneuver or an ability that targets an ally. Prayer effect: each ally within 10 squares gains temporary Stamina equal to twice your Intuition score.

subclasses.name: Nature
subclasses.summary: The domain of beasts, plants and the elements of the wild.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Faithful Friend (a main action ability that conjures an incorporeal animal spirit whose senses you share). Skill group: Exploration. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that you or a creature within 10 squares takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or sonic damage. Prayer effect: vines wrap a number of creatures equal to your Intuition score within 10 squares, and you can slide each up to your Intuition score in squares.

subclasses.name: Protection
subclasses.summary: The domain of wards and of shielding allies.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Protective Circle (10 minutes of work makes a circle that lasts 24 hours, and a creature inside it can't be targeted by strikes). Skill group: Exploration. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that you or an ally within 10 squares gains temporary Stamina, or uses a triggered action to reduce incoming damage or impose a bane or double bane on an enemy's power roll. Prayer effect: one ally within 10 squares gains temporary Stamina equal to four times your Intuition score.

subclasses.name: Storm
subclasses.summary: The domain of weather and lightning.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Blessing of Fortunate Weather (at each respite you choose the weather within 100 squares (clear, foggy, overcast or precipitation), each giving you and your allies an edge on certain tests). Skill group: Exploration. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that an enemy within 10 squares is force moved. Prayer effect: each enemy in a 3 cube within 10 squares takes lightning damage equal to twice your Intuition score.

subclasses.name: Sun
subclasses.summary: The domain of light and fire.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Inner Light (at each respite you give yourself or one ally a +1 bonus to saving throws until your next respite). Skill group: Lore. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that an enemy within 10 squares takes fire or holy damage. Prayer effect: one enemy within 10 squares takes fire damage equal to three times your Intuition score.

subclasses.name: Trickery
subclasses.summary: The domain of deceit and thievery.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Inspired Deception (when you test with an intrigue skill you have, you can use Intuition instead of another characteristic). Skill group: Intrigue. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that you or a creature within 10 squares takes the Aid Attack or Hide maneuver. Prayer effect: you slide one creature within 10 squares up to 5 + your conduit level squares.

subclasses.name: War
subclasses.summary: The domain of battle and bloodshed.
subclasses.description: 1st-level domain feature: Sanctified Weapon (as a respite activity you bless a weapon, giving its wielder +1 rolled damage with its abilities until your next respite). Skill group: Exploration. Piety: You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that you or a creature within 10 squares takes damage greater than 10 + your level in a single turn. Prayer effect: up to three allies within 10 squares, or yourself in place of one ally, each gain 2 surges.

properties.kit_note: Conduits don't use a kit. They choose a prayer and a ward instead.
properties.subclasses_text: Creation, Death, Fate, Knowledge, Life, Love, Nature, Protection, Storm, Sun, Trickery, War

source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Elementalist
summary: Air for movement. Earth for permanence. Fire for destruction. Water for change. Green for growth. Rot for death. Void for the mystery that which cannot be known. Years of study and practice and poring over tomes brought you the revelations that allow you to manipulate these building blocks of reality. Now you use your mastery of the seven elements to destroy, create, and warp the world with magic.
description:
Air for movement. Earth for permanence. Fire for destruction. Water for change. Green for growth. Rot for death. Void for the mystery that which cannot be known. Years of study and practice and poring over tomes brought you the revelations that allow you to manipulate these building blocks of reality. Now you use your mastery of the seven elements to destroy, create, and warp the world with magic.

As an elementalist, you can unleash your wrath across a field of foes, debilitate enemies, ward yourself and allies, manipulate terrain, warp space, and more. Your elemental specialization determines which of these talents you excel at.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with a Reason of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristic scores:
properties.skills: You gain the Magic skill. Then choose any three skills from the crafting or lore skill groups.

subclasses.name: Earth
subclasses.summary: Earth elementalists become harder to move and shape the ground itself.
subclasses.description: Specialization benefit, Acolyte of Earth: when you use an ability with the Earth and Magic keywords, your stability increases by 1 until the start of your next turn, cumulatively. 1st-level feature Motivate Earth: a main action to raise a 5 wall of mundane dirt, stone or metal, or to open or seal a 1-square opening in a structure. Triggered action: Skin Like Castle Walls.

subclasses.name: Fire
subclasses.summary: Fire elementalists specialize in destructive flames.
subclasses.description: Specialization benefit, Acolyte of Fire: abilities with the Fire and Magic keywords gain +1 to rolled damage, and so does Hurl Element when it deals fire damage. 1st-level feature Return to Formlessness: a main action to melt or burn one square of a mundane object. Triggered action: Explosive Assistance.

subclasses.name: Green
subclasses.summary: Green elementalists use growth and life magic to bolster themselves and their allies.
subclasses.description: Specialization benefit, Acolyte of the Green: when a Green and Magic ability that costs essence damages creatures, you or one creature within 10 squares gains temporary Stamina equal to your Reason score. 1st-level feature It Is the Soul Which Hears: you can speak with and understand animals, beasts and plant creatures, using Reason instead of Presence to influence them, and talk telepathically to a living plant. Triggered action: Breath of Dawn Remembered.

subclasses.name: Void
subclasses.summary: Void elementalists work the mystery of the void to see further and reach further.
subclasses.description: Specialization benefit, Acolyte of the Mystery: the distance of your Magic, Ranged, Void abilities increases by 2 squares. 1st-level feature A Beyonding of Vision: you see through illusions and invisibility, can't be concealed from by supernatural effects, and know if something is magical and what it does; you also gain the Shared Void Sense ability. Triggered action: Subtle Relocation.

properties.kit_note: Elementalists don't use a kit. They choose an enchantment and a ward instead.

source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Fury
summary: You do not temper the heat of battle within you. You unleash it! Your experience in the wild taught you the secrets of predators, and now, like the raptor, the panther, the wolf, you channel unfettered anger into martial prowess. Primordial Chaos is your ally. Let others use finesse to clean up the wreckage left in your wake.
description:
You do not temper the heat of battle within you. You unleash it! Your experience in the wild taught you the secrets of predators, and now, like the raptor, the panther, the wolf, you channel unfettered anger into martial prowess. Primordial Chaos is your ally. Let others use finesse to clean up the wreckage left in your wake.

As a fury, you devastate foes with overwhelming might, hurl yourself and enemies around the battlefield, and grow stronger as your ferocity increases. Nature has no concept of fairness—and neither do you.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with a Might of 2 and an Agility of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristic scores:
properties.skills: You gain the Nature skill. Then choose any two skills from the exploration or intrigue skill groups.

subclasses.name: Berserker
subclasses.summary: Berserkers turn ferocity into physical might.
subclasses.description: You have the Lift skill. 1st-level features: a kit, and Primordial Strength, which adds your Might score to damage when a weapon strike hits an object or you push a creature into one. Growing Ferocity gives Might-based benefits as your ferocity rises. Triggered action: Lines of Force.

subclasses.name: Reaver
subclasses.summary: Reavers turn ferocity into instinct and cunning.
subclasses.description: You have the Hide skill. 1st-level features: a kit, and Primordial Cunning, which means you are never surprised and can slide a target instead of pushing it. Growing Ferocity gives Agility-based benefits as your ferocity rises. Triggered action: Unearthly Reflexes.

subclasses.name: Stormwight
subclasses.summary: Stormwights turn ferocity into primordial storms and take animal or hybrid form.
subclasses.description: You have the Track skill. 1st-level features: Beast Shape, which lets you use a stormwight kit, and Relentless Hunter, which gives you an edge on Track tests. Triggered action: Furious Change.
subclasses.kit_note: Stormwight furies use a stormwight kit (Boren, Corven, Raden or Vuken) instead of these kits. Chronicle doesn't list the stormwight kits yet.

properties.kit_note: Berserker and reaver furies use a kit. Stormwight furies use a stormwight kit instead.

source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Null
summary: The mind is not separate from the body. Perfection of one requires perfection of the other. You strive for perfect discipline, perfect order, mastery over mind and body, becoming an unarmed psionic warrior who dampens and absorbs magic and psionics. You require no weapons, no tools. You suffice.
description:
The mind is not separate from the body. Perfection of one requires perfection of the other. You strive for perfect discipline, perfect order, mastery over mind and body, becoming an unarmed psionic warrior who dampens and absorbs magic and psionics. You require no weapons, no tools. You suffice.

As a null, you resist the supernatural forces of the universe with composure and confidence. As you strive for perfect order, you are an enemy of the ultimate expression of chaos: the supernatural. Those who break the laws of nature using sorcery or psionics should fear you.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with an Agility of 2 and an Intuition of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristic scores:
properties.skills: You gain the Psionics skill. Then choose any two skills from the interpersonal or lore skill groups.

subclasses.name: Chronokinetic
subclasses.summary: Chronokinetic nulls move through the flow of time as another dimension.
subclasses.description: You gain one skill from the lore group. 1st-level feature Chronokinetic Mastery: whenever you use Inertial Shield, you can use the Disengage move action as a free triggered action. As your discipline grows you gain more: at 2, Disengage before or after Knockback; at 4, 1 surge the first time on a turn you willingly move as part of an ability; at 6, an edge on Grab and Knockback.

subclasses.name: Cryokinetic
subclasses.summary: Cryokinetic nulls tap absolute cold and manifest it in their bodies.
subclasses.description: You gain one skill from the crafting group. 1st-level feature Cryokinetic Mastery: whenever you use Inertial Shield, you can then use the Grab maneuver as a free triggered action. As your discipline grows you gain more: at 2, Knockback targets one more creature and your psionic untyped damage can be cold; at 4, 1 surge the first time on a turn you grab a creature or an enemy moves in your Null Field; at 6, an edge on Grab and Knockback.

subclasses.name: Metakinetic
subclasses.summary: Metakinetic nulls see through the universe's illusions to understand their bodies and psionic potential.
subclasses.description: You gain one skill from the exploration group. 1st-level feature Metakinetic Mastery: whenever you use Inertial Shield, you can then use the Knockback maneuver as a free triggered action. As your discipline grows you gain more: at 2, Knockback moves the target extra squares equal to your Intuition score; at 4, 1 surge the first time in a round you take damage or are force moved; at 6, an edge on Grab and Knockback.

properties.kit_note: Nulls don't use a kit. They choose a psionic augmentation instead.

source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Shadow
summary: Subtlety is your art, the tip of the blade your brush. You studied at a secret college, specializing in alchemy, illusion, or shadow-magics. Your training and knowledge place you among the elite ranks of assassins, spies, and commandos. But more potent than any weapon or sorcery is your insight into your enemies' weaknesses.
description:
Subtlety is your art, the tip of the blade your brush. You studied at a secret college, specializing in alchemy, illusion, or shadow-magics. Your training and knowledge place you among the elite ranks of assassins, spies, and commandos. But more potent than any weapon or sorcery is your insight into your enemies' weaknesses.

As a shadow, you possess abilities that deal significant damage, enable you to move swiftly across the battlefield and evade hazards, and allow you to fade from notice even in the midst of the most intense combat encounters. You also possess more skills than any other hero.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with an Agility of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristic scores:
properties.skills_quick_build: Criminal Underworld, Hide, Lie, Pick Lock, Pick Pocket, Sabotage, Sneak
properties.skills: You gain the Hide and Sneak skills. Then choose any five skills from Criminal Underworld or the skills of the exploration, interpersonal, or intrigue skill groups.

subclasses.name: College of Black Ash
subclasses.summary: The college that founded the shadow art, known for teleportation, shadows and darkness.
subclasses.description: You have the Magic skill. 1st-level feature Black Ash Teleport: a maneuver to teleport up to 5 squares, with a free Hide and 1 surge if it ends in cover or concealment, and 1 more square per insight spent. Triggered action: In All This Confusion.

subclasses.name: College of Caustic Alchemy
subclasses.summary: The college of acids, bombs and poisons for exceptional assassins.
subclasses.description: You have the Alchemy skill. 1st-level features: Coat the Blade, a maneuver that gives you 2 surges which can deal poison damage, and Smoke Bomb, which lets you Hide while observed and shift your Agility score in squares first. Triggered action: Defensive Roll.

subclasses.name: College of the Harlequin Mask
subclasses.summary: The college of illusion magic for infiltration and orchestrated chaos.
subclasses.description: You have the Lie skill. 1st-level feature I'm No Threat: a maneuver that makes you look harmless, giving your strikes an edge and +1 shift distance on Disengage until you harm or touch a creature. Triggered action: Clever Trick.

omissions: The epigraph quotation and its attribution to a named institution are not reproduced; the class description is otherwise complete.
properties.subclasses_text: College of Black Ash, College of Caustic Alchemy, College of the Harlequin Mask
properties.provenance_display: omissions — The epigraph quotation and its attribution to a named institution are not reproduced; the class description is otherwise complete.

source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Summoner
summary: You are the armada. The kings of old would trade armies for your abilities. You've undertaken the tradition that conjures an endless supply of warriors. You are the summoner, the mage who takes their dreams and makes them manifest.
description:
You are the armada. The kings of old would trade armies for your abilities. You've undertaken the tradition that conjures an endless supply of warriors. You are the summoner, the mage who takes their dreams and makes them manifest.

You call forth minions to trudge fearlessly into the fray and provide support, holding the enemy at bay while you and your fellow heroes ready the counteroffensive. Your minions serve unflinchingly, unerringly, to their death or to yours.

You can also take advantage of powerful magic to buff your allies, whittle down your enemies, or enlist the fallen into your ranks. And when push comes to shove, you can call upon your champion to finish the fight.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with a Reason of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristics scores:
properties.skills: You gain the Magic and Strategy skills and can choose any two skills from the intrigue or lore skill groups.
properties.kit_note: Summoners don't use a kit at 1st level. They conjure their own kit at 3rd level.

source: Draw Steel: The Summoner (mcdm.summoner.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Tactician
summary: Strategist. Defender. Leader. With weapon in hand, you lead allies into the maw of battle, barking out commands that inspire your fellow heroes to move faster and strike more precisely. All the while, you stand between your compatriots and death, taunting the followers of evil to best you if they can.
description:
Strategist. Defender. Leader. With weapon in hand, you lead allies into the maw of battle, barking out commands that inspire your fellow heroes to move faster and strike more precisely. All the while, you stand between your compatriots and death, taunting the followers of evil to best you if they can.

As a tactician, you have abilities that heal your allies and grant them increased damage, movement, and attacks, even as you leave your enemies struggling to respond.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with a Might of 2 and a Reason of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristic scores:
properties.skills: You gain the Lead skill. Then choose any two skills from Alertness, Architecture, Blacksmithing, Brag, Culture, Empathize, Fletching, Mechanics, Monsters, Search, Strategy, or the skills of the exploration skill group.

subclasses.name: Insurgent
subclasses.summary: Insurgents do whatever it takes to keep their allies alive, fair play or not.
subclasses.description: You gain a skill from the intrigue group. 1st-level feature Covert Operations: you and allies in your presence gain an edge on intrigue tests, and you can use Lead to assist intrigue tests. Triggered action: Advanced Tactics.

subclasses.name: Mastermind
subclasses.summary: Masterminds treat the battlefield as a game board and think steps ahead.
subclasses.description: You gain a skill from the lore group. 1st-level feature Studied Commander: heroes with you treat war or battle Discover Lore projects as one category cheaper, and you can test Reason as a respite activity to learn about an upcoming encounter or negotiation. Triggered action: Overwatch.

subclasses.name: Vanguard
subclasses.summary: Vanguards lead from the front lines by force of will and personality.
subclasses.description: You gain a skill from the interpersonal group. 1st-level feature Commanding Presence: heroes with you treat their Renown as 2 higher in negotiations and have a double edge on tests to stop combat and start a negotiation. Triggered action: Parry.

properties.kit_note: Tacticians carry two kits and use both signature abilities. Chronicle keeps one kit here for now.

source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Talent
summary: Arare few people are born with the potential to harness psionic power, but only those who experience an awakening, a significant event that activates a talent's abilities, can tap into the mind's full potential. You are one of those people—a master of psionics and a source of incredible power created through sheer force of will. You can move and change matter, time, gravity, the laws of physics, or another creature's mind.
description:
Arare few people are born with the potential to harness psionic power, but only those who experience an awakening, a significant event that activates a talent's abilities, can tap into the mind's full potential. You are one of those people—a master of psionics and a source of incredible power created through sheer force of will. You can move and change matter, time, gravity, the laws of physics, or another creature's mind.

As a talent, you are limited only by the strength of your mind. But the ability to wield multiple powers at once and change reality at will involves a gamble. Every manifestation has a chance of harming you, and talents who use too much power too quickly pay a deadly price.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with a Reason of 2 and a Presence of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristic scores:
properties.skills: You gain the Psionics and Read Person skills. Then choose any two skills from the interpersonal or lore skill groups.

subclasses.name: Chronopathy
subclasses.summary: Chronopathy lets a talent view past and future events and manipulate time.
subclasses.description: 1st-level features: Accelerate, a maneuver that shifts the target your Reason score in squares (2 clarity also lets the target use a maneuver), and Again, a triggered ability that makes a target reroll an ability roll.

subclasses.name: Telekinesis
subclasses.summary: Telekinesis lets a talent physically move creatures and objects with the mind.
subclasses.description: 1st-level features: Minor Telekinesis, a maneuver that slides a target your Reason score in squares, and Repel, a triggered ability that halves damage or reduces forced movement for you or an ally.

subclasses.name: Telepathy
subclasses.summary: Telepathy lets a talent communicate with, read and influence minds.
subclasses.description: 1st-level features: Feedback Loop, a triggered ability that deals the attacker psychic damage equal to half the damage it dealt an ally, and Remote Assistance, a maneuver that gives an ally's next ability roll against a target an edge.

properties.kit_note: Talents don't use a kit. They choose a psionic augmentation and a ward instead.

source: Draw Steel Heroes Book, ch. 5 (mcdm.heroes.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Troubadour
summary: The whole world's a stage, and everyone on it, an actor. No one knows this better than the troubadour. You find energy in the drama of everyday life and know how to draw spectacle forth from even the most mundane of situations. You accent highs and deepen lows in service to whoever might witness your performance.
description:
The whole world's a stage, and everyone on it, an actor. No one knows this better than the troubadour. You find energy in the drama of everyday life and know how to draw spectacle forth from even the most mundane of situations. You accent highs and deepen lows in service to whoever might witness your performance.

As a troubadour, you chase drama. The insurmountable dangers of the world might cause many a hero to cower. But you take to that world stage not intending to die, but to find out if you are truly alive.

properties.starting_characteristics: You start with an Agility of 2 and a Presence of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other characteristic scores:
properties.skills: You gain the Read Person skill. Then choose two skills from the interpersonal skill group and one skill from the intrigue or lore skill groups.

subclasses.name: Auteur
subclasses.summary: Auteurs find drama in story and use magic to manipulate events.
subclasses.description: You have the Brag skill. 1st-level features: Blocking, a performance that teleports creatures in a 2 aura, and Dramatic Monologue, a maneuver granting an ally an edge or a surge, or giving an enemy a bane.

subclasses.name: Duelist
subclasses.summary: Duelists find drama in movement done in tandem with another.
subclasses.description: You have the Gymnastics skill. 1st-level features: Acrobatics, a 5 aura performance that lets you and allies get a tier 3 outcome on one jump, tumble or climb test, and Star Power, a maneuver giving +2 speed and a minimum tier 2 on your next power roll.

subclasses.name: Virtuoso
subclasses.summary: Virtuosos find drama in music and song.
subclasses.description: You have the Music skill and can play an instrument. 1st-level features: Power Chord, a 2 burst maneuver that pushes enemies, and Virtuoso Performances, the performances Thunder Mother and Ballad of the Beast.
